$comment: Machine-readable upstream metadata. Human guide: UPSTREAM.md. Updated by .github/workflows/upstream-sync.yml (sha.fetched/integrated) — never edit sha.pinned.

sync.cadence: 매주 월요일 00:00 UTC (09:00 KST) 예약 실행 + workflow_dispatch 수동 실행
sync.identity: deploy key "upstream-sync" (secret UPSTREAM_SYNC_SSH_KEY); fallback GITHUB_TOKEN with warning
sync.mergeStrategy: merge commit only (squash/rebase disabled at repository level)

role.reason: Miro Web SDK 앱. EventCatalog export JSON을 사용자가 직접 가져와 사용하며 core에 의존하지 않는다.

build.run: npm start  # vite dev 서버 http://localhost:3000 (Miro 보드 안에서만 기능)
build.smoke: npm run build 후 dist/index.html, dist/app.html 존재

main: required review 1 (admin bypass for PR merge)
vendor/upstream-main: updates only by sync identity (deploy key)
protection.note: GitHub rulesets on public repos (Free plan). appliedAt is filled when rulesets are active.
